endCard.title: The Signal Fire
endCard.subtitle:
The pyre burns, and the dark has an edge again.
You finished Zero The Hero. Thank you for carrying the flame.

death.epitaph:
Nothing made sense,
it was all for nothing.

lockedLines.speaker: npc
lockedLines.text: It's too dark... I can barely think.

lockedLines.speaker: narrator
lockedLines.text: The person stares at the dead fire, shivering.

lockedLines.speaker: npc
lockedLines.text: Light the fire. When this place is safe, we can talk.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The old wizard adjusts his hat. For a moment, his eyes meet yours.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I have waited for this moment for ages.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You have come from lands far away.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You are Zero... the last heir of a forgotten crusade.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: But you are not a knight yet.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You still have to become one.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Speak to me again... there is something you must hear.

protect.speaker: narrator
protect.text: The wind blows through the ruins.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: This is the last flame of the world.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: Beyond its light there is only darkness... and the cold hearths of those who came before.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: I can feel them out there. Dead fires, scattered across the land. Waiting.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: Cut dead wood, wake the branch in this flame... and carry the fire into the dark.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: An axe lies abandoned on the north road. The dry trees still remember how to burn.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: Light even one dead fire, and return to me.

protect.speaker: npc
protect.text: As long as the flame travels... the world can still be reborn.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: You carried the flame, and a dead hearth breathes again.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: What was only a spark now begins to light the world.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: Other fires still sleep out there... and the deep places under the portals still hold what the ancients buried.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: The flame that will save this world is the same one that burns within you.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: Do not let it go out.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: Now look north, to the stone cradle standing alone in the open. That is a PYRE, and it has waited longer than I have.

prophecy.speaker: npc
prophecy.text: Build it high with dead wood and set your torch to it. A fire that size is not warmth, Zero — it is a SIGNAL. Every hearth still sleeping out there will see it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A hero. How novel. I was napping.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That branch beside me? Take it. Hold it into my fire and it wakes as a TORCH.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Two hearths in this clearing sit cold. Carry the flame to them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Light draws a line the dead will not cross. I sleep better behind lines.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hello! I'm a completely normal NPC.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He smiles in a way that doesn't look natural.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'm not a mimic. That would be absurd.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His eyes don't blink. Not once.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please, keep walking.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My ship is a shell now. What she still needs is IRON — and this crater keeps it locked inside rock.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take the PICKAXE. The veined boulders never run dry: three good swings, one lump of ORE.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ore is not iron yet. Two stones make a FURNACE on that bench, and stone plus ore makes an ALTAR — the slab you hammer on.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Burn dead wood into CHARCOAL in the furnace, smelt it with ore for a SPONGE, then lay the sponge on the altar and strike it three times.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Finish it by hand on the altar. Bring me a bar and the ship gets one step closer to flying.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Timber. That is the market now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This AXE is yours — consider it an advance. It fells DEAD wood in a chop or two.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My dry ranks stand in rows. Clear them, and the sticks are pure profit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Sticks build bridges. Bridges open markets. Work hard.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Suit says the pool up north-east glows. Molten ground is no road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take this STONE. Throw it into lava and it cools into a basalt step.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Something metal sank by the little island. One good step opens the route.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The basalt stays behind. Cross back carrying whatever you find.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Zero! Perfect timing. This field is a canvas, and it is BLANK.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take these SEEDS. My pigments. The beds along the south edge are already dug.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Stand before a bed and press A to plant. Water wakes them — rain, or a bucket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Green is a colour you GROW. Paint me a meadow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Friend! You look thirsty. Or dry. Either way — opportunity.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Free sample: this BUCKET. Fill it in my pond, just west of the fire.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A full bucket waters crops and drowns small fires. Endless uses. Zero coins. Today only.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tell your friends. If you find any out there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The pines sing, but they crowd the verse.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This GREAT AXE fells even LIVING trees — the small axe only knows dead wood.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Open a clearing in my grove. Listen how the song changes where light falls.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Every good line needs its silence. Cut me one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The dark did not leave us a world. It left us choices.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take the sword. The dead on unfinished roads still carry coin.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Stand on a road seal and press B. Spend what you earn, and decide what exists next.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You bought your way here, field by field. I watched your furnace smoke cross three of them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This is where the road stops. Everything past me is unbuilt — no cards, no coins, no dark to light.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So: the prologue is over, and you are the one who finished it. Thank you for testing my small world.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go back and light something. I will wait. Waiting is the one thing I am good at.
